  "recovered_c": "#include <stdint.h>\n#include <stddef.h>\n\nuint64_t fn_03(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  if (len == 0) {\n    return 1;\n  }\n  uint32_t uVar3 = 1;\n  uint32_t uVar2 = 0;\n  const uint8_t *pbVar4 = in + len;\n  const uint8_t *param_1 = in;\n  while (pbVar4 != param_1) {\n    uint8_t bVar1 = *param_1;\n    param_1 = param_1 + 1;\n    uVar3 = (uVar3 + bVar1) % 0xfff1;\n    uVar2 = (uVar2 + uVar3) % 0xfff1;\n  }\n  return (uint64_t)(uVar2 << 0x10) | (uint64_t)uVar3;\n}"
